The present writ petition has been filed for following reliefs:-
"(i) For issuance of an appropriate writ(s), order(s), direction(s) or a writ in the
nature of Mandamus for directing and commanding upon the Respondent no. 1 to 3
to refer the dispute between the petitioner and the Respondent no. 6 to 8 to the
authority under the Right to 2026:Jhhc:2767 Fair Compensation and Transparency
in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
(ii) For issuance of an appropriate writ(s), order(s), direction(s) upon the Respondent
no. 5 to freeze the Bank account of Respondent no.6 having account no.
39731685621, Ifsc Sbin0015347 of Code-State Bank of India, Ormanjhi Branch with immediate
effect till the disposal of the instant writ petition."

entities.text: State Bank of India, Ormanjhi Branch
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. The private respondents are awardees.

The petitioner claims that he also has a claim over the said
piece of land and has alleged manipulation in his settlement deed.
3.  However, learned counsel for the respondents have submitted that the award has been passed following due process of law and there is no interpolation.
4. In view of above submission, such disputed questions of fact require adjudication by a competent authority.
For adjudication of such disputes, a special forum has been created under the National Highways Act, 1956, under Section 3-H(4).

5. Considering the nature of dispute raised in the present writ petition, the Competent Authority under the National Highways Act, 1956 is directed to refer the matter for proper adjudication as per Section 3-H(4).
6. In view of above direction, the present writ petition is hereby disposed of.
7. Pending I.A., if any, also stands disposed of.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Dated: 03rd February, 2026 Amar/-
